simple: Protects computers and servers (Windows, macOS, Linux, VDI) with a single agent, managed from the cloud or on premises. Blocks malware, ransomware (with recovery of encrypted files), exploits, communication between infected machines and attacker servers (Anti-Bot), and fileless attacks by behavior; uses Check Point ThreatCloud threat intelligence and its own indicators of compromise. Automatically collects forensic data and builds an attack report mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, and lets you hunt for threats. Includes a host firewall, USB port and device control, application control, a check that the computer complies with policies, and a VPN client for remote access. In the browser, it blocks phishing sites, including brand-new ones (Zero Phishing), filters URLs, turns on safe search and doesn’t let employees enter a corporate password on a third-party site. Checks suspicious downloaded files in a sandbox (Threat Emulation) and immediately hands back a cleaned copy (Threat Extraction). Encrypts computer disks and removable media. Automatically finds vulnerabilities and installs updates (Posture Management); prevents data leaks — controls file uploads, the clipboard and the use of generative AI (DLP & GenAI Security); Endpoint XDR correlates events from other Check Point products, manages incidents and responds automatically using Infinity Playblocks playbooks.
